text.en: Daycare staff receive consistent appreciation from pet parents for their energetic, hands-on involvement with young dogs. Clients highlight how attentive team members remain to individual personality quirks, communicating progress openly so owners can reinforce training commands at home. The staff are frequently credited with helping shy puppies gain confidence.

Many clients describe their dogs bounding towards the door with excitement, arriving home delightfully tired after structured group play and sensory enrichment sessions. However, one owner reported significant frustration after their puppy developed persistent tugging habits during play sessions. While most dogs flourish happily here, enrichment styles may not suit every pet.

Several owners report remarkable developmental progress through the puppy preschool curriculum, noting improved confidence and dependable command responses in public settings. Conversely, a client was disappointed with the supervised play activities and discontinued attendance early on. Overall feedback remains largely favourable despite occasional divergent outcomes.

q.en: What services does Wag Days Pet Resort offer?

a.en: The facility provides dog daycare, structured puppy preschool enrichment programmes, and overnight boarding services.

q.en: Do owners receive daily updates during daycare or boarding?

a.en: Yes, clients consistently report receiving daily report cards with photos and activity updates through their online portal and social media.

q.en: Is an initiation or trial day required before regular daycare?

a.en: Yes, dogs undergo an initial evaluation and orientation period to assess temperament and ensure a safe group environment.
